d:
Ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly Elections, a new political narrative is emerging around Akhilesh Yadav's planned visit to the Ram Temple in Ayodhya on December 12. Is the Samajwadi Party chief trying to counter the BJP's Hindutva politics with a temple strategy of his own?
From the 1990 firing on Kar Sevaks under Mulayam Singh Yadav's government to the Babri Masjid demolition on December 6, 1992, Ayodhya remains one of the most sensitive political and emotional issues in Uttar Pradesh.
